content_units: Cape Town Mid-January Forecast Snapshot

Cape Town looks mostly pleasant for your 5-day trip, with warm daytime temperatures and cooler evenings. Expect a mix of sunny weather at the start and end of the trip, with a wetter and windier patch in the middle.
The warmest day is   Jan 16   at   29°C  , while the coolest day is   Jan 14   with rain and a high of   22°C  . Winds stay noticeable throughout, especially on the rainy days.
Day-by-Day Weather and Packing Fit
Day   Condition   Temp   Rain Chance   Wind   Humidity   UV   What to wear
Jan 12   Sunny   27°C / 18°C   Low   18 km/h   Moderate   High   T-shirt, light trousers or shorts, walking shoes, sunglasses
Jan 13   Light rain   24°C / 17°C   Moderate   22 km/h   Moderate   Medium   Light layers, breathable top, walking shoes, packable rain jacket
Jan 14   Rain   22°C / 16°C   High   28 km/h   Higher   Low-Med   Long pants, light waterproof layer, comfy closed shoes
Jan 15   Partly cloudy   25°C / 17°C   Low   20 km/h   Moderate   Medium-High   T-shirt with light overshirt, comfortable walking outfit
Jan 16   Sunny   29°C / 19°C   Low   15 km/h   Moderate   High   Light summer clothes, hat, breathable walking shoes
What to Pack for Walking Tours and One Nice Dinner
-   2-3 breathable tops   for warm afternoons
-   2 bottoms   such as lightweight trousers, chinos, or shorts
-   1 light sweater or layer   for evenings and breezy conditions
-   1 packable rain jacket   or light waterproof shell for Jan 13-14
-   Comfortable walking shoes   with decent grip
-   A second pair of shoes or sandals   for dry, warm days
-   Hat, sunglasses, and sunscreen   for the sunnier days
-   Small day bag   for water, sunscreen, and a light layer
-   Compact umbrella   if you prefer extra rain backup
For the nicer dinner:
-   Smart-casual outfit   works well: a casual dress, or chinos with a collared shirt/blouse
-   Light jacket or wrap   for the evening
-   Clean casual shoes   or simple dress shoes that still feel comfortable
Trip Comfort Assessment

This is a good forecast for a leisure trip centered on walking. The only real caution is the   wettest, windiest period around Jan 13-14  , so plan your longest outdoor walks for   Jan 12, 15, or 16   if possible.
